scope: Synthetic forward updates on an owned local real-component stack; no hosted adoption, data recovery or production acceptance

checks.name: fresh receipt records the baseline without inventing historical migration entries
real Auth accounts, two-subject learning evidence and private Storage fixture exist
own-account access and other-account/private-file denials hold before updates
a competing update lock refuses a second runner without writes
unexpected schema drift refuses the whole update before execution
missing declared data prerequisite refuses the update without replaying history
unexpected resulting structure rolls back SQL and the receipt
attempted learning-evidence deletion is refused and restored by rollback
attempted existing account-data rewrite is refused and rolled back
SQL failure in a later update rolls back the complete pending batch
first future update and its exact receipt commit together
changed previously applied update is refused even with the same resulting structure
appending an update resumes from the recorded prefix without repeating earlier work
repeat execution is a verified no-op
an older plan cannot omit an already-applied update
receipt tampering is detected
receipt-schema permission drift is detected
learning evidence, real profile isolation and private file bytes/access survive both updates
browser and service roles cannot read or edit update receipts
owned containers, temporary database/files and network are removed

publication: Safe hashes/counts/assertion names only; no fixture credentials, identifiers, row contents or service logs
productionQa: not run (paused by owner); affected suites: none
